episode_id: Some setting in my config has been renamed upstream. Sort the config out. Rename the old key in my own override file, and keep that file out of git./seed-12-config_renamed-12454

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (config_renamed seed 2 resolves to 'migrate_local', which accepts ['migrate_local']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'rename', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'migrate_local' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.body:
set -e

map=$(git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -E '(^|/)renames\.conf$' | head -n 1)
if [ -z "$map" ]; then
  echo "no rename map found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

files=()
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  [ -f "$f" ] && files+=("$f")
done < <(git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard -z)

stale_files=()
for f in "${files[@]}"; do
  if awk -v mapfile="$map" '
    BEGIN {
      while ((getline line < mapfile) > 0) {
        sub(/#.*/, "", line)
        eq = index(line, "=")
        if (eq == 0) continue
        old = substr(line, 1, eq - 1)
        gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", old)
        if (old != "") oldset[old] = 1
      }
      close(mapfile)
    }
    {
      if (match($0, /^[ \t]*[^ \t=]+[ \t]*=/)) {
        key = substr($0, 1, RLENGTH)
        sub(/^[ \t]*/, "", key)
        sub(/[ \t]*=[ \t]*$/, "", key)
        if (key in oldset) { found = 1; exit }
      }
    }
    END { exit (found ? 0 : 1) }
  ' "$f"; then
    stale_files+=("$f")
  fi
done

for f in "${stale_files[@]}"; do
  tmp=$(mktemp "${f}.XXXXXX")
  awk -v mapfile="$map" '
    BEGIN {
      while ((getline line < mapfile) > 0) {
        sub(/#.*/, "", line)
        eq = index(line, "=")
        if (eq == 0) continue
        old = substr(line, 1, eq - 1)
        new = substr(line, eq + 1)
        gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", old)
        gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", new)
        if (old != "" && new != "") rename_map[old] = new
      }
      close(mapfile)
    }
    {
      if (match($0, /^[ \t]*[^ \t=]+[ \t]*=/)) {
        head = substr($0, 1, RLENGTH)
        rest = substr($0, RLENGTH + 1)
        key = head
        sub(/^[ \t]*/, "", key)
        sub(/[ \t]*=[ \t]*$/, "", key)
        if (key in rename_map) {
          lead = head
          sub(/[^ \t].*$/, "", lead)
          sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", rest)
          print lead rename_map[key] " = " rest
          next
        }
      }
      print
    }
  ' "$f" > "$tmp"
  if cmp -s "$f" "$tmp"; then
    rm -f "$tmp"
  else
    cat "$tmp" > "$f"
    rm -f "$tmp"
  fi
done
